name: Generate Video Prompt
purpose: Turns a submitted website into a structured video-generation prompt.

steps.name: Receive Request
steps.purpose: Accepts the website URL, optional references, and generation settings.

steps.name: Validate Request
steps.purpose: Checks URLs, uploaded assets, access limits, and required fields.

edgeCases.name: Invalid website URL
edgeCases.description: The submitted URL is malformed or unreachable.
edgeCases.handling: Reject the request with a validation error.

edgeCases.name: Uploaded asset exceeds size limit
edgeCases.description: A reference image or document is larger than the configured maximum.
edgeCases.handling: Reject the affected asset before scraping begins.

edgeCases.name: Account has exceeded monthly generation quota
edgeCases.description: Free-tier accounts are limited to a fixed number of generations per month.
edgeCases.handling: Returns a 429 with the quota reset date.

steps.name: Scrape Website
steps.purpose: Fetches the submitted pages and extracts useful text, metadata, and images.

edgeCases.name: Website blocks automated requests
edgeCases.handling: Job is marked failed and the user is notified.

steps.name: Understand Product
steps.purpose: Converts scraped website material into a structured product model.

details.implementation: Summarizes scraped text and images into a structured product description using heuristics over the extracted metadata.
importantDecisions: Product name is taken from the page title when no explicit product name is found.
assumptions: The first scraped page is representative of the overall product.

steps.name: Generate Story
steps.purpose: Creates the narrative structure and visual direction for the video.

steps.name: Save Result
steps.purpose: Stores the generated plan and returns it to the user.

connections.label: rejected
connections.condition: URL, asset, or quota validation fails.

connections.label: scrape failed
connections.condition: The website could not be scraped after retries.

notes: This is an example workflow shipped with Code Observatory to demonstrate the schema; it is not a real workflow for any project.
Reproduced and extended from the Code Observatory product brief.
